yorum: The hotel is a modest bungalow. The price/quality ratio isn't justified. The only plus is the location by the sea. Granted, it's only a two-star hotel, but in Turkey, I'd still like to see glasses and a kettle in the room. The bathroom only has hot water in the shower, and even then, it takes a while. When using the shower or sink, the entire floor gets soaked. A toilet paper holder would be nice, though. The hairdryer doesn't work! The breakfast is very modest. But when they brought us a share of the omelet for two, it was too much. However, after I voiced my dissatisfaction, they finally brought a second omelet. And I must say, the staff was completely indifferent.
